name: brand-mark
description: Brand mark: the flow's only identity element — the logo, or the brand name as text when there is none.
provenPattern: Derived from 28 real requests that had been met with hand-built workarounds — the band counterpart of those arrangements.

knowledge.purpose: Telling the user where they are in a navigation-less flow
antiPatterns: Linking the brand to the home page — it offers a way out of the flow
Putting a long heading in place of the brand
Moving the mark to the middle of the page — it sits at the start of the flow

placeholders.{{LOGO}}: OPTIONAL brand image URL, drawn 28px tall (width follows the picture) IN PLACE of the name; leave it empty ("") when there is no logo and the name is drawn as text
placeholders.{{BRAND}}: brand name as TEXT (the site/app name) — drawn when there is no logo (a logo already carries the name) and always the logo's alt; needs no logo
